description: Collect public Pinterest Pins, profiles, boards, board Pins, search results, and comments with optional detail enrichment. All fields are source-backed and optional.

boardUrls.description: Public board links or username/board-name paths.
boardUrls.title: Board URLs

commerceOnly.description: Keep only Pins with source-backed product or shopping metadata.
commerceOnly.title: Shoppable Pins only

cookies.description: Optional Cookie Editor JSON export. The actor works without cookies; never share this secret publicly.
cookies.title: Optional Pinterest cookies

cookiesJson.description: Compatibility alias for pasting a Cookie Editor JSON export.
cookiesJson.title: Optional cookies JSON (alias)

endPage.description: Maximum number of pages to paginate through. Set to 0 for unlimited.
endPage.title: End Page

enrichDetails.description: When enabled, each pin from search/profile/board results will be enriched with accurate stats (reaction count, follower count, etc.) by fetching its detail page. Slower but more complete data.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich Details

excludeAds.description: Exclude Pins Pinterest marks as promoted or sponsored.
excludeAds.title: Exclude promoted Pins

imageOnly.description: Exclude Pins that Pinterest identifies as video.
imageOnly.title: Images only

includeComments.description: When enabled, add one real comment/activity row for each collected Pin. Pinterest's public cookieless comment path is used automatically.
includeComments.title: Include Pin comments

keywords.description: One or more words or phrases for search modes.
keywords.title: Search words

maxComments.description: Maximum public comment/activity rows to add per Pin when comments are enabled.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per Pin

maxItems.description: Maximum number of items to scrape. Set to 0 for unlimited.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPages.description: Maximum pagination pages per search, profile, or board. 0 means continue until Pinterest has no next page.
maxPages.title: Max pages

minCreatorFollowers.description: Keep Pins only when Pinterest supplies a creator follower count at or above this value.
minCreatorFollowers.title: Minimum creator followers

minSaves.description: Keep Pins only when Pinterest supplies at least this many saves.
minSaves.title: Minimum saves

mode.description: Choose a collection type. Auto-detect accepts mixed public Pinterest links.
mode.title: What to collect

pinUrls.description: Public Pin links or numeric Pin IDs.
pinUrls.title: Pin URLs or IDs

pinterestUrls.description: Compatibility alias for Pin URLs or IDs.
pinterestUrls.title: Pin URLs or IDs (compatibility alias)

proxy.description: Optional proxy settings. Not required — works without proxy from datacenter IPs.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration

proxyConfiguration.description: Compatibility alias for proxy. Direct public Pin/profile pages also work without a proxy.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (alias)

requireOutboundLink.description: Keep only Pins with a public destination link supplied by Pinterest.
requireOutboundLink.title: Require destination link

search.description: Keyword to search on Pinterest. Results will be pins matching this query.
search.title: Search Query

startUrls.description: List of Pinterest URLs to scrape. Supports pin URLs, user profile URLs, board URLs, and search URLs.
startUrls.title: Pinterest URLs

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only rows explicitly marked verified by Pinterest.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified accounts only

title: Pinterest Data Extractor Input
